title: Evaluation and Metrics
summary: Computes performance metrics, generates visualizations, and produces evaluation reports for benchmark runs. Integrates metric calculation, annotation workflows, and result presentation into a cohesive evaluation pipeline.

nodes.label: Calculate Performance Metrics
nodes.title: Metric Computation
nodes.description: Computes quantitative metrics (accuracy, BLEU, F1, etc.) on model outputs. Supports classification, generation, summarization, and image quality assessment across diverse task types.

nodes.label: Manage Annotations
nodes.title: Annotation Workflow
nodes.description: Orchestrates human and automated annotation processes. Handles annotator selection, result aggregation, and quality control for evaluation tasks.

nodes.label: Aggregate Results
nodes.title: Result Aggregation
nodes.description: Combines metrics and annotations into structured result sets. Prepares data for downstream visualization and reporting.

nodes.label: Generate Visualizations
nodes.title: Visualization Generation
nodes.description: Creates plots, charts, and interactive dashboards. Renders performance comparisons, trend analysis, and robustness summaries for human review.

nodes.label: Produce Evaluation Reports
nodes.title: Report Generation
nodes.description: Synthesizes metrics, visualizations, and metadata into comprehensive evaluation reports. Outputs JSON, HTML, and summary documents for stakeholders.

groups.label: Evaluation Core
groups.title: Core Evaluation
groups.description: Metric computation and annotation management form the foundation of evaluation, producing raw scores and labeled data.

groups.label: Result Pipeline
groups.title: Result Processing
groups.description: Aggregates evaluation outputs and prepares them for presentation through visualization and reporting.
